bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
py="$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active || exit 70
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 71
"$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 72
git -C "$r" fetch -q origin test/room-live-editor-layout-userbot-20261113
test "$(git -C "$r" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = 23c19b89c64241919bfde7b8e881ac98e1328c70 || exit 73
git -C "$r" show 61784676d81c00203355228c9040fdcf98f5cb74:scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py | cmp -s - "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" || exit 74
old_inode=$(stat -c %i "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")
tmp=$(mktemp "$r/scripts/.userbot_room_public_smoke.XXXXXX")
git -C "$r" show FETCH_HEAD:scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py > "$tmp"
python3 -B - "$tmp" <<'PY'
import ast,sys
ast.parse(open(sys.argv[1],encoding='utf-8').read())
PY
backup=$(mktemp "$r/scripts/.userbot_room_public_smoke_backup.XXXXXX")
cp -p "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py" "$backup"
chmod 644 "$tmp"
mv "$tmp" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"
if ! systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service; then
 cp -p "$backup" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || :
 echo ROOM_UI_USERBOT_ACTIVATION_ROLLBACK
 exit 75
fi
ready=no
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active && "$py" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health >/dev/null 2>&1; then ready=yes; break; fi
 sleep 1
done
if test "$ready" != yes; then
 cp -p "$backup" "$r/scripts/userbot_room_public_smoke.py"
 systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service || :
 echo ROOM_UI_USERBOT_HEALTH_ROLLBACK
 exit 76
fi
test "$(stat -c %i "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = "$old_inode" || exit 77
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 78
echo ROOM_UI_USERBOT_TEST_CODE=ACTIVATED
echo ROOM_UI_RESIDENT_AUTH_AND_SESSION=PRESERVED
